fusions.name: Flicked Silk
fusions.desc: Flicks a sticky strand that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Canopy Ambush
fusions.desc: Drops from overhead onto every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 28 damage as a guaranteed critical hit and leaving each [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Strung Snare
fusions.desc: Takes 1 second to string a snare at the nearest enemy. It arms after 2 seconds and waits up to 20 seconds; the first enemy within 2 tiles sets it off, and it deals 20 damage in a blast around it.

fusions.name: Shoulder Spinner
fusions.desc: A bonded spinner rides your shoulder, biting enemies within 4 tiles for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds and slowing them 15% for 2 seconds.
